faq.q: If I submit this, will my loan be approved?
faq.a: No. The decision is made by Japan Finance Corporation's own review, and this service does not guarantee it. What we help with is the ground your interview stands on — checking and aligning the numbers and the form, mechanically.

faq.q: Will you prepare or file the documents on my behalf?
faq.a: No. This service supports the drafting of a business plan. You submit it yourself. We do not prepare or file documents for submission to public offices on your behalf, and we do not handle tax or visa documents.

faq.q: How do the numbers check (¥1,980) and the full draft (¥22,000) differ?
faq.a: The numbers check is the light version: from six inputs, the machine confirms your debt service coverage, own-funds ratio, and what is left after repayment. The full draft delivers a draft (PDF) with all 8 sections filled plus a repayment-consistent cash-flow table (CSV). The result of the check carries straight over into the full draft.

Within 14 days of delivery we make up to two revisions free of charge, within the scope of what you declared. Adding new facts (a change of business, for example) may fall outside that scope. Just reply to the delivery email.
Please check your spam folder first. If it still hasn't arrived, contact us and we will confirm and resend.
